structured_output.mechanisms: Time = fixed ~0.7s + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost is affine in stage widths (c1, c2 dominate; c3 cheap), sublinear in batch (~bs^0.8), reduced by low-res phases (~78% of pixel-ratio saving), plus Muon overhead. Accuracy rises with epochs (saturating), width, and Muon (+0.8pt). It falls with cutout, translate4, random flip, label smoothing away from 0.1, and low-res phases (~0.5pt).
